Vanatome atlas asset attribution

The GLB models and related manifest distributed in public/models/ are
browser-oriented adaptations of:

“Z-Anatomy — The libre 3D atlas of anatomy”
Created by Gauthier Kervyn (design, 3D, anatomy) and Marcin Zielinski
(Python script), with additional authors and upstream assets documented by the
project.

Project source: https://github.com/Z-Anatomy/Models
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Vanatome modifications include web export, structure selection identifiers,
material adjustments, curve-to-mesh conversion, and geometry optimization.
The Ieobom viewer also distributes separate, unmodified-coordinate lazy layers
for available regional muscular meshes. These layers are split by viewer focus
region only to reduce the initial browser download.

The complete head lazy layer is extracted from the official
Z-Anatomy/Models-of-human-anatomy repository at commit 32693313. Ieobom
converts curves to meshes, assigns stable system metadata, removes two-vertex
taxonomy helpers and redundant external surface regions, and exports the
remaining 738 renderable head structures as a browser GLB.

The complete upper-body lazy layer uses the same official source. Ieobom
extracts the trunk and both upper limbs through the wrists, removes structures
already present in the initial core plus taxonomy helpers, external regions,
hands, and pelvis-only structures, and exports 1,094 supplemental structures.
Both complete-region GLBs use Draco geometry compression without removing
anatomical objects. The browser decoder is distributed from Three.js under MIT.

Z-Anatomy documents models derived from:
“BodyParts3D — The Database Center for Life Science”
https://dbarchive.biosciencedbc.jp/en/bodyparts3d/download.html

The MIT license for Vanatome viewer code does not relicense these atlas assets.
Preserve the relevant attribution, indicate modifications, and follow the
applicable ShareAlike terms when redistributing adapted atlas material. Refer
to ASSET-LICENSE.md and the upstream notices for further provenance.
